title: Descendant Selector
body:
Two selectors separated by a **space**: matches the right-hand one only when it is somewhere
inside the left-hand one, at any depth.

```css
#first div  { ... }   /* every div inside #first */
ul li a     { ... }   /* anchors inside list items inside a ul */
```

The space is the operator, which is why `p.box` and `p .box` mean completely different things:
the first is an [[And Selector]], the second is this. `>` restricts it to *direct* children
instead of any descendant. See [[CSS Selectors]].
